items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: I bought a Carl Fisher clarinet book. And, uh, he started me off. He started me off on a clarinet.

ctx.x: Albert system. I bought a clarinet.

I bought a Carl Fisher clarinet book. And, uh, he started me off. He started me off on a clarinet. And I went down hard practicing it. So, when my mother got sick, I comes home. When I comes home, I leave the boys out there. Well, I was right on the clarinet. Regular. Until here, Big Eye Louie, he came off an open circuit with a C-Mell and a saxophone.
You were telling me you came home, something about Big Eye Louie came. C-Mell and a saxophone. Oh, yeah. Came off the open circuit.
